title: Super-Exponential Advantage of Squeezed Light in Phase Estimation under Discrete Phase Randomisation
summary: A paradigmatic task in quantum metrology is that of phase estimation. For this task it is commonly believed, under reasonable assumptions about prior information, that a quadratic advantage in sensitivity is the maximum possible advantage offered by the use of quantum resources. In this work, we consider a channel that implements a phase shift by an angle $2πk/M$, where $k$ is a uniformly random unknown integer, in addition to a small unknown phase shift of interest.
